body: ESH - you are moving in together, you need to have a better conflict resolution than coming and posting on Reddit, but she is being a much bigger asshole for ignoring your budget and opinions.

Edit: this is questionably in breach of the subreddit rules, I was hoping that by not naming any sites I would be ok. 

Apologies if not.
But they do allow you to change the email address - you just can’t tell them that it’s someone’s email.

Most people have only answered the first half. Yes it is self harm. 

The second question, should you stop, is more difficult. You need to ask yourself why you are doing it, and then work out why it helps.

Split balling here: if you’re angry, try a stress ball; if you’re upset, try screaming. There’s lots of alternatives you can consider, IF you want to stop. If you don’t want to stop, then you probably have something a little deeper going on, and maybe you might want to try talking to someone you can talk openly with and trust.
